item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear about the stakes: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop it from being built.

2. We reject a future in which the race to build superintelligent AI ends in mass death. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working for a ban.

3. We cannot accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent that catastrophe.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not accept that outcome as the price of progress. We are working toward a ban on superintelligence because preventing this catastrophe requires stopping its construction, not merely promising to manage the consequences. We need public understanding, political resolve, and enforceable limits that put human survival ahead of the race to build more powerful machines. We have a responsibility to act before that race reaches its destination. Our task is clear: stop superintelligence from being built and protect the future we all share.
